text_en: The Song of Songs, which is Solomon’s.
Let him kiss me with the kisses of his mouth! For your love is better than wine,
text_cn: 愿君以热吻与我接吻！因为你的爱抚甜于美酒。

text_en: your anointing oils are fragrant, your name is perfume poured out; therefore the maidens love you.
text_cn: 你的香气芬芳怡人，你的令名香液四射，为此少女都爱慕你。

text_en: Draw me after you, let us make haste. The king has brought me into his chambers. We will exult and rejoice in you; we will extol your love more than wine; rightly do they love you.
text_cn: 愿你拉着我随你奔跑！君王，愿你引我进你的内室；我们都要因你欢乐踊跃，赞叹你那甜于酒的爱抚；怪不得众少女都爱慕你！

text_en: I am black and beautiful, O daughters of Jerusalem, like the tents of Kedar, like the curtains of Solomon.
text_cn: 耶路撒冷女郎！我虽黑，却秀丽，有如刻达尔的帐棚，又似撒耳玛的营幕。

text_en: Do not gaze at me because I am dark, because the sun has gazed on me. My mother’s sons were angry with me; they made me keeper of the vineyards, but my own vineyard I have not kept!
text_cn: 你们不要怪我黑，是太阳晒黑了我。我母亲的儿子向我发怒，派我去看守葡萄园；而我自己的葡萄园，我却没有去看守。

text_en: Tell me, you whom my soul loves, where you pasture your flock, where you make it lie down at noon; for why should I be like one who is veiled beside the flocks of your companions?
text_cn: 我心爱的！请告诉我：你在哪儿放羊？中午又在哪儿卧羊？别令我在你伴侣的羊群间，独自徘徊！

text_en: If you do not know, O fairest among women, follow the tracks of the flock, and pasture your kids beside the shepherds’ tents.
text_cn: 女中的佳丽！你若不知道，出去跟踪羊群的足迹，靠近牧人的帐棚，牧放你的小羊。

text_en: I compare you, my love, to a mare among Pharaoh’s chariots.
text_cn: 我的爱卿！我看你好似牝（pìn）马，套在法郎的御车上。

text_en: Your cheeks are comely with ornaments, your neck with strings of jewels.
text_cn: 你的双颊配以耳环，你的颈项绕以珠链，何其美丽！

text_en: We will make you ornaments of gold, studded with silver.
text_cn: 我们要为你制造金链，嵌上银珠。

text_en: While the king was on his couch, my nard gave forth its fragrance.
text_cn: 君王正在坐席的时候，我的香膏已放出清香。

text_en: My beloved is to me a bag of myrrh that lies between my breasts.
text_cn: 我的爱人有如没药囊，常系在我的胸前；

text_en: My beloved is to me a cluster of henna blossoms in the vineyards of En-gedi.
text_cn: 我的爱人有如凤仙花，生在恩革狄葡萄园中。

text_en: Ah, you are beautiful, my love; ah, you are beautiful; your eyes are doves.
text_cn: 我的爱卿，你多么美丽，多么美丽！你的双眼有如鸽眼。

text_en: Ah, you are beautiful, my beloved, truly lovely. Our couch is green;
text_cn: 我的爱人，你多么英俊，多么可爱！我们的床榻，是青绿的草地。

text_en: the beams of our house are cedar, our rafters are pine.
text_cn: 香松作我们的屋梁，扁柏作我们的屋椽（chuán）。
